subject: uk-aisi-inspect-integration

metrics.extension_model: First-class extension APIs — publish own package, listed at inspect.aisi.org.uk/extensions.html
metrics.contribution_policy: Issue-first: must get issue labeled 'accepted' before PR. PRs without accepted issue auto-closed.
metrics.approach: Submit GSPC as an Inspect extension (pip installable) that runs 22-axis measurement on any model, emits signed CSOAI receipt
metrics.integration_path: inspect-gspc-eval: pip install inspect-gspc → inspect eval inspect-gspc/gspc --model anthropic/claude → signed receipt
metrics.prerequisite: Open issue describing GSPC as evaluation extension. Wait for 'accepted' label. Then submit code.
metrics.timeline: Sep 15: Open issue. Sep 16-20: Build extension. Sep 21-25: Submit PR. Sep 27: Demo at AI Growth Lab.
metrics.why_this_works: AISI explicitly designed Inspect for external evaluations. Extensions are first-class. CSOAI doesn't need permission — just build an extension that interoperates.

honest_sentence: AISI Inspect (MIT, 2756 stars) has first-class extension APIs and an issue-first PR policy. CSOAI can submit a GSPC evaluation extension that runs 22-axis measurement and emits signed receipts — interoperability by doing, not branding.
